scripts.install:all: npm install && cd client && npm install
scripts.db-path: node -e "require('dotenv').config();const {dbPath,getDb}=require('./server/db');const db=getDb();const r=db.prepare('SELECT COUNT(*) as c FROM products WHERE status=?').get('sold');db.close();console.log('DB path (exact path app uses):',dbPath);console.log('Sold count in this file:',r.c);"
scripts.db-verify: npm run db-path-file 2>/dev/null; echo 'Sold count (from file on disk via sqlite3):'; sqlite3 $(cat .db-path.txt 2>/dev/null) "SELECT COUNT(*) FROM products WHERE status='sold';" 2>/dev/null || echo 'Install sqlite3 or run: sqlite3 <path> "SELECT COUNT(*) FROM products WHERE status='\''sold'\'';"'
